verdict.rationale: Bun documents that `bun install` creates a text-based `bun.lock`, and that `--frozen-lockfile` gives reproducible installs by installing the exact locked versions without updating the lockfile. That directly covers getting the same resolved versions from a lockfile. Community crash reports concern install stability, not version drift, so they do not contradict the claim. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of identical resolutions across machines, documentation of lockfile integrity/checksum verification

support.subject: As a developer, I can install dependencies from a lockfile and get the exact same resolved versions on every machine

citations.quote: For reproducible installs, use `--frozen-lockfile`. Bun installs the exact versions specified in the lockfile and does not update it.
Bun v1.2 changed the default lockfile format to the text-based `bun.lock`.
